name: Add Protected Range
description: Add edit protection to cell range with permissions. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request#AddProtectedRangeRequest)

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: sheetId
configurable_props.label: Spreadsheet ID
configurable_props.description: Select a spreadsheet or provide a spreadsheet ID

configurable_props.name: worksheetId
configurable_props.label: Worksheet ID
configurable_props.description: Select a worksheet or provide a worksheet ID

configurable_props.name: protectedRangeId
configurable_props.label: Protected Range ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the protected range (required for update and delete operations). This is a unique identifier assigned by Google Sheets

configurable_props.name: range
configurable_props.label: Range
configurable_props.description: The range of cells to protect (e.g., `A1:A10`). Required for add and update operations

configurable_props.name: description
configurable_props.label: Description
configurable_props.description: A description of the protected range

configurable_props.name: requestingUserCanEdit
configurable_props.label: Requesting User Can Edit
configurable_props.description: If true, the user making this request can edit the protected range

configurable_props.name: protectors
configurable_props.label: Protectors
configurable_props.description: Email addresses of users/groups who can edit the protected range (e.g., user@example.com)
